title: ⚡ Bolt: Optimize reading time calculation to reduce CPU load
body:
💡 What: The optimization replaces dynamic string parsing (`str_word_count(strip_tags($content))`) with `get_post_meta()` calls to fetch pre-computed `vp_reading_time` metadata.
🎯 Why: The original method was a severe CPU bottleneck, particularly inside loop structures like search results or lists of posts.
📊 Impact: Reduces CPU overhead substantially during page rendering by relying on fast O(1) post meta cache retrievals instead of intensive string manipulations on potentially massive text blocks.
🔬 Measurement: Verified via `php -l` for syntax correctness. The change maintains fallback compatibility for posts lacking the meta entry to ensure robustness.
